requirement.original: Fix silent data loss bug in POI agents — merge_agent_days replaces entire day object instead of merging at slot level. Implement --merge-slots flag and merge_agent_slots() function. See spec Section 5 for the 7-item acceptance criterion.
requirement.clarified: Add --merge-slots CLI flag to scripts/save.py and merge_agent_slots() in scripts/lib/json_io.py that merges at the slot/key level within each day (preserving keys not present in update). Update 6 POI agent prompts to use --merge-slots. Keep --merge-days for timeline. Create audit-data-loss.py script and an integration test.
requirement.what: Slot-level merge function + CLI flag + 6 agent prompt updates + audit script + integration test
requirement.why: Partial-day updates from POI agents silently wipe sibling slots due to full day-object replacement in merge_agent_days(). Confirmed data loss: Day 2 breakfast+lunch wiped in data/china-20260412-092624/meals.json (commit 47fccd4).

included: 6 POI agent prompt updates (meals, accommodation, attractions, entertainment, shopping, cafe)

success_criteria: Partial update of Day 2 dinner only does NOT affect Day 2 breakfast or lunch
All 6 POI agent prompts use --merge-slots in Step 3 save command
plan-validate.py reports no new HIGH severity errors after partial update
scripts/audit-data-loss.py runs without error and outputs results
constraints: Backward compatibility: --merge-days semantics must not change
merge_agent_slots() must handle both named-slot (meals, accommodation) and array-based (attractions, entertainment, shopping, cafe) day structures
--merge-days and --merge-slots must be mutually exclusive in save.py CLI
Do not modify transportation.md or budget.md without explicit user approval

root_cause_analysis.symptom: POI agent partial-day update wipes sibling slots in the same day — e.g., saving only dinner destroys breakfast and lunch
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: merge_agent_days() at scripts/lib/json_io.py:367 performs full day-object replacement: existing_days_map[day_num] = update_day. No key-level merge logic exists.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — logic deficiency present since merge_agent_days() was introduced; not a regression from a single commit
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: merge_agent_days() was designed for timeline agent (whole-day recalculation) and was then reused for POI agents without adapting for partial-day (slot-level) updates
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: POI agents emit only the slots they updated. When this partial day object replaces the full existing day object, all un-emitted slots are destroyed.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Issue was always present in merge_agent_days(). Confirmed data loss instance in commit 47fccd4 (2026-04-13 13:14) for data/china-20260412-092624/meals.json.
observations: scripts/lib/json_io.py:367: existing_days_map[day_num] = update_day — full replacement, inferred from Read tool
